description: This file defines the Task model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically for handling database operations related to scheduled tasks within the system (e.g., adding tasks, retrieving task counts). It is part of the catalog model layer in the setting module.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Model class for managing scheduled task entries in the database, including adding new tasks and retrieving task counts.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Creates a new task record in the database with provided data including code, action, args, and status.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Associative array containing task details such as code, action, args, status, etc.

methods.name: getTotalTasks
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of task records, optionally filtered by code and status.
